name: nix_list_items
description: List an item's direct children (id, title, type, whether it has children) with their property values: dueDate, startDate and completed when the task fields exist, other values under properties. Omit parentId to list the workspace root. Read-only; reads may run without a card; changes always ask for approval.

name: nix_search
description: Search this workspace by title or content. Read-only; reads may run without a card; changes always ask for approval.

name: nix_read_item
description: Read one item's id, title, type and workspace. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_read_note
description: Read a note's Markdown body. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_read_structure
description: Read an item's declared and effective fields, its views and its child count. Call this before proposing any structure change. Read-only.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_create_note
description: Create a new note with title and markdown, under parentId (omit for the workspace root). Shown for approval before it runs.

name: nix_append_note
description: Append Markdown to a note's body. Never replaces existing content.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_replace_section
description: Replace one section of a note: the blocks from the heading named heading up to the next heading of the same or higher level. The rest of the note is untouched. If markdown does not start with a heading, the original heading is kept. Refuses when the heading is missing or not unique. Call nix_read_note first. Never replaces a whole note's body.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

heading.description: The exact heading text, without # marks (case is ignored); must be unique in the note.

markdown.description: The new Markdown for that section.

name: nix_replace_passage
description: Fix text inside one paragraph, heading, list item text or code block: find must occur exactly once in the note and inside a single block (no list markers). Only that block is rewritten. Call nix_read_note first.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

find.description: The exact Markdown text to replace, up to 240 characters.

replace.description: The Markdown text to put in its place; may be empty.

name: nix_rename_item
description: Rename an item. Never changes anything else about it.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_move_item
description: Move an item under a new parent. Supply an empty parentId to move it to the workspace root.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_set_properties
description: Set one or more of an item's property values. Call nix_read_structure first.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

properties.description: One or more property values, keyed by field key (see nix_read_structure).

name: nix_trash_item
description: Move an item to trash. Recoverable with nix_restore_item; never permanent.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_restore_item
description: Restore a trashed item.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_create_structured
description: Create a new item with a recipe, fields and views, under parentId (omit for the workspace root). Shown for approval before it runs.

name: nix_add_view
description: Add fields and views to an item's existing schema. Never removes or retypes a field, never deletes an existing view.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_create_entries
description: Create up to 25 child entries under parentId in one call.

values.description: Values are keyed by field key (see nix_read_structure), never by field label.

name: nix_add_fields
description: Add up to 20 new fields to an item's existing schema. Never removes or retypes an existing field.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_edit_form
description: Replace one existing interactive form view, optionally adding new fields to the item at the same time.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_set_recurrence
description: Set or replace a recurring due-date rule on an item.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

name: nix_list_templates
description: List templates available in this workspace, optionally filtered by query. Read-only.

name: nix_read_template
description: Read one template's details. Read-only.

name: nix_apply_template
description: Apply a template to create a new item under parentId (omit for the workspace root), filling any inputs the template declares. Shown for approval before it runs.

name: nix_read_calendar
description: Read every dated item in this workspace's calendars between from and to (inclusive, at most 31 days): title, container, date, end date, and completion for repeating tasks. Read-only.

to.description: The last day, yyyy-MM-dd, at most 30 days after from.

name: nix_complete_task
description: Mark a task done (completed true) or not done (false). A repeating task completes its current occurrence and moves on to the next. Refuses an item with no completion field. Shown for approval before it runs.

itemId.description: The exact item UUID. Discover it with nix_list_items or nix_search first if not already known.

completed.description: true to mark it done, false to reopen it.
